zh.chartTitle: 两款减肥茶的「惊人效果」对比（单位：kg）

textRefs.debunk_axis: Y 轴起点被抬到了 0.9——A 与 B 的差距被视觉放大了好几倍！真实起点应为 0，B 其实只比 A 多减了 0.1kg。
textRefs.debunk_cherry: 「A 产品 · 后」这根柱只统计了效果最好的那两周——选择性展示数据！把全程平均算进去，差异就没这么夸张了。

manual: 检查 Y 轴起点是不是 0
数据是不是只挑了好日子
hints: 看看 Y 轴从几开始——0 才是诚实的起点
图表展示的是全部数据，还是只挑了最好看的？
zh.explanation: 这张图动了两个手脚：①Y 轴从 0.9 起，把 0.1kg 的微小差异放大成「两倍差距」的错觉；②只挑选效果最好的时段展示。看任何图表先问三件事：坐标起点诚实吗？数据完整吗？样本有代表性吗？

textRefs.debunk_axis: The Y axis starts at 0.9 — the gap between A and B is visually exaggerated several times over! The honest baseline is 0; B only beat A by 0.1 kg.
textRefs.debunk_cherry: The "Tea A · after" bar only counts the best two weeks — cherry-picked data! Averaged over the whole period, the difference is far less dramatic.

manual: Check whether the Y axis starts at 0
Is the data cherry-picked from the best days?
hints: Look at where the Y axis starts — 0 is the honest baseline
Does the chart show all the data, or only the best-looking part?
en.explanation: This chart cheats twice: ① the Y axis starts at 0.9, turning a tiny 0.1 kg difference into the illusion of a "two-fold gap"; ② it only shows the best-performing period. When reading any chart, ask three things: is the axis baseline honest? Is the data complete? Is the sample representative?
